''See also: [[Dark Space Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Dark Space is a vast galactic frontier that encompasses all territory not claimed by other major powers, making it larger than the [[Union]], the Alliance, and the [[Free Worlds]] combined. It is characterized as a mysterious region of adventure located on the edges of known space and maps. The area serves as a refuge for various entities, including splinter factions from the [[Galactic Union]] takeover who fled there to rebuild their strength, as well as creatures originating from [[Subspace]]. Notable [[inhabitants]] or entities associated with this region include the star-eating psychic insect [[Esh’kinaar]] and various splinter groups. The border of this territory is identified by the Alliance as being near the [[Fifty-Three X]] system.}}

== The Captain ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-01-the-captain|Dark Space serves as the territory belonging to the [[Iron Legion]], a group whose life-supporting planets are scattered throughout the region. Following the death of the previous [[Iron King]], the [[Legion]] was reduced to splinters and scattered across this expanse. The area has recently drawn attention due to a reported archaeological dig occurring on its border. Navigational maps are used to track a ship's position in relation to the edge of this location.}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">5</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=lh-01-the-captain|An archaeological dig was reported on the border of [[Dark Space]].<ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c5">''The Captain'', chapter 5</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=lh-01-the-captain|The [[Iron Legion]] was reduced to splinters and scattered across [[Dark Space]] after the death of the previous [[Iron King]].<ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c18">''The Captain'', chapter 18</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=lh-01-the-captain|[[Dark Space]] is a location where the [[Iron Legion]] belongs.<ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c22">''The Captain'', chapter 22</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=lh-01-the-captain|The [[Iron Legion]]'s life-supporting planets are scattered throughout [[Dark Space]].<ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c28">''The Captain'', chapter 28</ref>}}</li>

== The Knight ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|Dark Space serves as the destination toward which the [[D’Niss]] swarms have traveled. This location is a place where entities may experience [[hunger]] and contains a specific sector situated on its edge. It is believed that [[Sel’miroth]] may have returned from this realm, where the entity [[Esh’kinaar]] also lurks. Currently, a [[D’Niss]] incursion is taking place on the edge of Dark Space and is treated as originating from within it.}}
